title: Relocate backups and generated output to .local/
description:
Move atomic-write crash backups and rendered markdown output from the tracked `.planner/` tree into `.planner/.local/`.

Code references:
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:169` — `atomicWriteText()` creates `path.bak` and `path.tmp.*`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1917` — `writeGenerated()` writes to `generatedDir()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:918` — `createSpaApp()` in `@agent-plan/server` serves static files
- `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:725` — `startServer()` / `resolveStaticDir()`
- `packages/plan-web-ui` — build output copied to `packages/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist` and served via server

Current state:
- Every `atomicWriteJson` creates a `.bak` next to the source file, producing git churn.
- `generated/` is inside `.planner/` and is regenerated entirely on many operations.

Work to do:
1. Add path helpers:
   - `localRoot()` → `.planner/.local/`
   - `backupPath(sourcePath)` → `.planner/.local/backups/<relative>.bak`
   - `generatedDir()` → `.planner/.local/generated/`
2. Update `atomicWriteText()` to copy the backup into `.local/backups/` instead of next to the source, and to write the temp file into `.local/tmp/` (or keep temp next to target but gitignored).
3. Update `writeGenerated()` to write into `.local/generated/`.
4. Update `serve.ts` (`@agent-plan/server`) and `pi-adapter` static resolution to serve generated markdown and the web bundle from the new paths.
5. Update `scripts/copy-web-ui.sh` if it copies to a path under `pi-adapter/web-ui-dist`; verify it still serves from the relocated location.
6. Add cleanup logic for stale backups (e.g. keep last N or age-based prune) to prevent unbounded disk growth.

Behaviors to preserve:
- Crash recovery must still work: if `atomicWriteText` fails mid-write, the previous version must be recoverable from `.local/backups/`.
- Web UI must continue to see live updates when `.planner/` files change (watcher points to `.planner/` root; verify it still covers `.local/` if needed).
- Generated markdown must remain human-readable and reachable for debugging.

tasks.title: Move atomic backups to .local/backups/
tasks.description:
Relocate crash backups from source-adjacent `.bak` files into `.planner/.local/backups/`.

Concrete steps:
1. Add `backupPath(sourcePath)` helper that maps a source path under `.planner/` to a backup path under `.planner/.local/backups/` (preserve relative directory structure).
2. Update `atomicWriteText()` to write the backup to `.local/backups/` instead of `${path}.bak`.
3. Keep temp files next to target but ensure they are written into `.local/tmp/` or continue to be gitignored; avoid `.bak` churn.
4. Update backup cleanup / orphan removal logic to scan `.local/backups/`.
5. Verify crash recovery still works: previous version must be restorable from `.local/backups/`.
6. Update existing `.gitignore` handling (`.local/` already covers backups).

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented as part of P042 commit: atomicWriteText and atomicUpdateJson now compute backup paths under .planner/.local/backups/ from the local root. Verified via migration test.

tasks.title: Relocate updatePhase crash-backups into .local/backups (stop inline .bak leak)
tasks.description:
## Current state
PlanStore writes a previous-version crash backup on every atomic write. The backup target is decided by the optional `root` arg in `atomicWriteText` / `atomicUpdateJson` (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:233-300):
- when `root` is passed → backup at `<root>/.local/backups/<rel>.bak` (correct, per P043)
- when `root` is omitted → backup INLINE at `<dir>/<file>.bak` (leaks into the working tree)

Every write passes `this.root` EXCEPT `updatePhase` (plan-store.ts:2065-2071), which calls `atomicUpdateJson(this.phasePath(phaseId), PhaseSchema, …)` without `this.root`. Result: every phase *update* leaves `.planner/phases/<id>.json.bak` inline next to the source file, while phase *creates* (line 2057), project/requirements/feature writes all correctly land in `.local/backups`. The file is gitignored (`*.bak`) so it is never committed, but it pollutes the working tree and is inconsistent with P043's goal of relocating backups into `.local/`.

## Coupling (must keep crash-recovery working)
- `readJson` fallback (plan-store.ts:553-558) reads `${path}.bak` (INLINE) to recover a corrupted/missing main file. Moving updatePhase backups to `.local/backups` would break that recovery unless readJson also checks `.local/backups`.
- `deletePhase` (plan-store.ts:2396-2397) unlinks the inline `${path}.bak`; must also remove the `.local/backups` copy or it orphans.
- `cleanupOrphanBackups` (plan-store.ts:1544+) scans `.planner/` + phasesDir for inline `*.json.bak`/`*.tmp.*`; extend to `.local/backups` orphans.

## Steps
1. `updatePhase` (line 2071): pass `this.root` as the 4th arg to `atomicUpdateJson`.
2. `readJson`: add optional `root?` param; on read failure try (a) legacy inline `${path}.bak`, then (b) `join(root, ".local", "backups", rel + ".bak")` when `root` is a prefix of `path`. Thread `this.root` at the key read call sites (`getPhase` 1187, `loadFeatures`, `loadAllPhases`, `loadRequirements`).
3. `deletePhase` (line 2397): also `unlink` the `.local/backups/phases/<id>.json.bak` copy.
4. `cleanupOrphanBackups`: also scan `.local/backups` and drop `*.json.bak` whose main file no longer exists.

## Edge cases
- Old repos may still contain inline `.planner/phases/<id>.json.bak` from before this fix — keep the legacy inline fallback in readJson so they still recover; cleanupOrphanBackups removes them once stale.
- `rel` must preserve the subpath (`phases/<id>.json`) so backups do not collide in `.local/backups` root.
- Do NOT change `.gitignore` (already ignores `*.bak` and `.local/`).
- Re-run `pnpm check` + plan-core/web-ui tests; verify no inline `.bak` appears after a phase update and that a corrupted phase file still recovers from `.local/backups`.

---
**Completion summary:**
Fixato il leak di `.bak` inline in plan-store.ts (T301 / P043). Causa: `updatePhase` chiamava `atomicUpdateJson` senza `this.root`, quindi il backup finiva inline in `.planner/phases/<id>.json.bak` invece che in `.local/backups`. Modifiche: (1) `updatePhase` ora passa `this.root`; (2) `readJson` tenta prima il `.bak` inline legacy, poi `.planner/.local/backups/<rel>.bak` (root derivato risalendo il path, senza toccare i 14 call site); (3) `deletePhase` rimuove anche la copia in `.local/backups`; (4) `cleanupOrphanBackups` scandisce ricorsivamente `.local/backups` e rimuove gli orfani. Verifiche: `pnpm check` verde su plan-core e plan-web-ui; test backup (read-diagnostics) 4/4 verdi (recovery da inline e da `.local/backups` funzionante). I 9 fallimenti residui nella suite di plan-core sono in display-status/task-selection/phase-task-validation (P059/T253, già modificati sul branch e estranei ai backup). File toccati: packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts. Non committato (regole di progetto).
